headline: Argentina Debt Risk Rises to 939 Points Following US Midterms
summary: Argentina's country risk indicator climbed to 939 points around the time of the US midterms, while officials in Buenos Aires maintained that US interest persists.
why: Sovereign risk spreads reflect market perceptions of debt sustainability and emerging market borrowing costs.

impacts.name: Argentina Sovereign Debt
impacts.why: Rising risk premium indicates higher perceived likelihood of default.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Debt risk jumped following political developments around the US midterms.
